# Non-Goals

- No immediate rewrite of the editor, renderer, or kernel.
- No generic third-party plugin marketplace or sandbox before a real product
  requirement.
- No route per editor mode by default.
- No binary WASM transport without measured JSON/serialization evidence.
- No second canonical code artifact.
- No timeline-first animation architecture.
- No broad abstraction created only to improve folder aesthetics.
- No migration stage that changes document schema or command semantics without
  a separately reviewed proposal and rollback checkpoint.
